# oxlint-plugin-raula Reference

Experimental. Read this file before editing JSX className/style usage or *.module.css imports.

## Rules

- [raula/no-css-modules](./references/no-css-modules.md) — Disallow importing `*.module.css` files.
  - files: **/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}
- [raula/no-inline-style-prop](./references/no-inline-style-prop.md) — Disallow inline style props in JSX so styling remains centralized and consistent.
  - files: **/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}
